config.experiment: Experiment 82.2 PSCE — Prompt-guided Spectral Counterfactual Evidence Learning
config.covariance: unbiased n-1; pooled weighted by n_c
config.selection: strict ACC improvement on test; retain earliest tie
config.preprocessing: historical pre-CV scaling/RFE; transductive graph; val=test preserved
config.eigen_tie_rule: gaps <= 1e-12 max absolute eigenvalue: coordinate-projector canonicalization; stable signed tie order; sign largest absolute coordinate positive
config.degenerate_rule: trace <= epsilon: zero term; overall norm <= epsilon: complement total covariance fallback
config.teacher: Per-epoch current original OutputLayer deepcopy, detached eval, legal training raw CAM only, no RNG
config.go_rule: All requested classification, anonymous-control, target-alignment, text-impact and net-correction conditions; otherwise PARTIAL only for positive data-driven evidence, else NO-GO

decisions.base: Only E74.4 G2 path, initialized exclusively from E61 epoch10 complete state.
decisions.historical_path: Actual vendor PLNNoPEN InputLayer -> Encoder/FeedForward -> flatten CAM144 -> original OutputLayer; no SPGS/PEN reintroduction.
decisions.output: Original LayerNorm(144), Linear(144,36), GELU, Dropout, Linear(36,2), log_softmax. Eval teacher clone reuses mlp_head and classifier to obtain pre-softmax logits.
decisions.spectral: Exact E82 Original O algorithm in CPU float64, PCA8 plus orthogonal covariance-difference8; frozen.
decisions.ssc: Reference DBPC distributed prompt budgets, SKP text spectral energy, redundancy and entropy fusion; PSCE directions are patient CAM spectrum, not SSC text spectrum.
decisions.text: Exact original eight RN50 embeddings; reuse audited fixed common text geometry rule, no trainable text projection. Only q0 differs between groups.
decisions.target: ReLU(D)/(sum ReLU(D)+EPS), detached; valid-target mass audited against EPS regularization. Tolerance fixed 1e-6.
decisions.teacher: Deepcopy current head once before each training forward; eval, requires_grad False, no_grad. Hook-free, label access limited to legal training. No extra original head call.
decisions.limitations: Controlled bounded feature masking, not full removal or medical causal effects. Current-model teacher may induce self-distillation; trainable key/token may absorb query rotations.

audit_engineering_events.reason: Before independent audit: add requested cross-fold training-target/test-performance descriptive correlations and EPS target-mass diagnostic. No formal training code, config, parameters, checkpoints, or RNG changed.

scientific_conclusion.no_additional_training: Stop this second-module route on NO-GO; no E82.2.1 tuning or new experiment.

interpretation_addendum.text_effect: Detectable but very small. One boundary-crossing flip does not establish a non-negligible, stable medical contribution. The original automatic boolean counts hard flips only.
interpretation_addendum.formula: Cosine matrix of the eight saved per-prompt mean attention distributions, excluding diagonal, averaged within fold then over ten folds.
interpretation_addendum.medical_alignment: Medical better than same-Best anonymous query in 9/10 folds and spectral weights in 8/10, but these are legal-training current-model targets, not medical truth.
interpretation_addendum.generalization: G2 ACC/BA/Prob-AUC below DARG on both all10 and without_fold2. More target alignment did not show a positive cross-fold link with test ACC increment (G2 Spearman -0.0522).
interpretation_addendum.decision: NO-GO unchanged. No further training or tuning.

interpretation_finalization.reason: Clarify detectable versus non-negligible text effects; add mean-distribution homogeneity and ASD/TD correction interpretation from audited predictions.
